# Assumption Map (Risk × Uncertainty)

## Assumptions (List First, Then Rank)

### Customer
- [ ] Who is the buyer?
- [ ] Who is the daily user?
- [ ] What segment has the sharpest pain?

### Problem
- [ ] How frequent is the problem?
- [ ] What triggers the search for a solution?
- [ ] What is the current workaround / alternative?

### Solution / Outcome
- [ ] What measurable outcome improves?
- [ ] Why is your approach meaningfully better?
- [ ] What must be true for the product to actually work?

### Price / Willingness to Pay
- [ ] What budget does it come from?
- [ ] What is the “no-brainer” price?
- [ ] What price requires approval / procurement?

### Channel / Acquisition
- [ ] Where do target customers discover solutions?
- [ ] Can you reach them at acceptable CAC?
- [ ] What message makes them take the next step?

### Retention
- [ ] Why will they keep using it?
- [ ] What creates switching costs or habit?
- [ ] What causes churn?

### Ops / Delivery
- [ ] What support burden is likely?
- [ ] What reliability/SLA expectations exist?
- [ ] What integrations are required?

### Constraints (Integrity)
- [ ] Privacy/security constraints
- [ ] Regulatory constraints
- [ ] Safety / harm risks
